result.description:
USVD Consultants Pty Ltd (ACN 666 075 065) ABN: 80 993 362 158 is a recruitment company having office at Bella Vista NSW 2153.

Our client APS, Australasian Protective Services (ABN 69 084 470 995) is a Premier Security Company and it is a 100% Australian owned company that provides customisable solutions, including cash in transit, physical manpower presence and technology security solutions to their clients all across Australia. They specialize in tailored electronic security solutions for organizations of all sizes and industries. Electronic security refers to the utilization of advanced technology, such as CCTV cameras, electronic alarm systems, and drone technology, to conduct comprehensive security checks on premises. APS assures safety and security and it is their top priority. 

Due to the business growth and expansion plans, USVD is now looking to recruit  Electronic Equipment Trades Worker(s) in their Technology team on a permanent full-time basis.

Position Title: Electronic Equipment Trades Worker
Location: Laverton North VICTORIA 3026
Reports to: Technology Leader 
No. of position: 02
Offered Salary range: $80,000.00 - $85,000.00 plus Super 

Role purpose:
Electronic Equipment Trades Workers install, maintain and repair electronic equipment and systems such as audio and visual reproduction equipment, home entertainment systems, computers and electronic security systems. As an Electronic Equipment Trades Worker, your duties and responsibilities include:
•	Installing, configuring and commissioning electronic equipment such as CCTV systems, security alarm systems, access control systems, audio-visual equipment, communication systems and electronic control devices.
•	Examining and testing electronic systems and components to diagnose faults using specialised diagnostic tools and electronic testing instruments.
•	Dismantling faulty equipment, identifying defective components and repairing or replacing circuit boards, wiring, connectors, sensors and electronic modules.
•	Reassembling equipment and conducting functional testing to ensure proper performance and compliance with operational specifications.
•	Reading and interpreting circuit diagrams, schematics and technical manuals to perform accurate installation and troubleshooting.
•	Performing routine servicing and preventive maintenance to ensure reliability and reduce equipment failure.
•	Installing and terminating structured cabling and low-voltage wiring systems in accordance with safety regulations.
•	Maintaining documentation including service reports, installation records and compliance documentation.
•	Advising clients and end users on correct system operation, maintenance procedures and safety requirements.
•	Ensuring all work was carried out in compliance with WHS regulations and relevant Australian Standards.

Qualification & Licences:
•	Certificate III in Electronics and Communications or equivalent Tertiary qualifications in Electrical or Electronics engineering.
•	At least 3 years of proven work experience in installing and maintaining electronic equipment or systems. 
•	Strong fault-finding abilities and familiarity with electronic diagnostic tools. 
•	Understanding of WHS requirements, particularly in industrial and construction environments. 
•	Ability to interpret technical drawings, manuals, and specifications.
Skills:
•	Strong organizational and time management skills 
•	Strong problem-solving skills 
•	Excellent attention to detail 
•	Ability to multitask 
•	Process and results driven 
•	Effective communicator, both written and verbal 
•	Team player; collaborative 
•	Resilient, patient and adaptable 
•	Enthusiastic, self-motivated 
•	Proactive 

Additional information: 
•	Ability to work outside of normal business hours on occasion when installing or upgrading components. 
•	Ability to travel interstate, if required.
result.title: Electronic Equipment Trades Worker

result.description:
Position: Office Manager
Type: Full-time
Employer: International College of Australia Pty Ltd trading as Western Sydney College
Location: Parramatta NSW 2150
Salary: $80,000 - $85,000 p/a
About the Business:
International College of Australia Pty Ltd trading as Western Sydney College is a dynamic Registered Training Organisation (RTO 45360) and CRICOS provider (03690M) dedicated to delivering practical, industry-focused vocational education and training. With a strong presence in Parramatta, the College offers nationally recognised qualifications under the Australian Qualifications Framework across a range of sectors including business, leadership and management, information technology, kitchen and hospitality management, community services, civil construction, and more. Committed to empowering international and domestic students through flexible blended learning, hands-on practical training, English language pathways, and comprehensive welfare support, Western Sydney College fosters a supportive, inclusive, and vibrant learning environment. The College values innovation, student success, strong industry connections, and compliance excellence, creating a collaborative workplace culture where staff contribute to shaping future leaders while enjoying opportunities for professional growth in a fast-paced educational setting.
About the Position:
The Office Manager plays a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth and efficient daily operations of Western Sydney College’s Parramatta campus. This position is responsible for overseeing administrative functions, managing resources and teams, maintaining compliance with regulatory standards (including ASQA and CRICOS requirements), and supporting the delivery of high-quality vocational education services. Reporting to senior management, the Office Manager will drive operational improvements, coordinate campus activities, and contribute to the College’s commitment to student success and organisational excellence in the international education sector.
Key Responsibilities:
Contribute to planning, review, and improvement of office services and operational standards.
Allocate and manage human resources, workspace, and equipment for efficient campus operations.
Direct and supervise administrative teams, delegate responsibilities, and monitor staff performance.
Manage office budgets, financial accounts, invoicing, and documentation systems.
Liaise with departments, trainers, and external professionals to resolve operational issues.
Oversee sourcing, maintenance, and inventory of office equipment and supplies.
Ensure compliance with Occupational Health & Safety regulations and workplace procedures.
Ensure work processes comply with legislation, RTO policies, ASQA standards, and procedures.
Coordinate personnel activities including hiring, promotions, payroll, training, and supervision.
Manage campus scheduling, trainer allocations, and classroom coordination.
Support compliance preparation, internal audits, and reporting cycles.
Implement office policies, administrative procedures, and operational workflows.
Collaborate with senior management and stakeholders on operational planning.
Prepare operational and compliance reports and maintain administration systems.
Coordinate vendors and service providers for procurement and facility maintenance.
Monitor compliance deadlines, regulatory updates, and internal procedures.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
At least an AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma.
Minimum 1 year of experience in office administration.
Strong organisational and leadership skills with the ability to manage teams, budgets, and multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Position Overview: 

We are currently seeking motivated and reliable individuals who can work as a Harvest Picker, Production Line Worker and Farm Hand and join our team in Mataranka, NT. These roles are essential to the continued success of our farm operations and provide a great opportunity to work in a dynamic, outdoor environment. 

You may be required to work in any of these roles which is dependent on operational needs and availability of the day. 


Job Descriptions: 

 As a FARM HAND, will assist in the efficient operation and management of the farm. Crops being produced on our farms include mangoes, seedless watermelon, rockmelons, broccoli, and pumpkin.

About the role:
• Operate small tractors to transport fruit.
• Participate in the inspection, grading, sorting, storage, and post-harvest treatment of crops.
• Perform general farm labouring tasks.
• Perform daily pre-start checks.
• Record basic information about crops.
• Dig and plant seeds, or transplant seedlings by hand.
• Harvest fruits and vegetables by hand.
• Load agricultural products into trucks, and drive to storage facilities.

As a PRODUCTION LINE WORKER, you will assist in all-round stock controlling, picking, packing and quality assurance of produce. 

About the role: 
• Receiving incoming goods, checking for damage and for discrepancies between goods and packing orders.
• Unloading vehicles, opening packages, and removing contents.
• Labelling goods with details of storage location.
• Packing and weighing goods and sealing boxes.
• Assisting with regular stocktakes.

As a HARVEST PICKER, your role will include, but are not limited to:

• Picking fruit and vegetables according to size and ripeness by hand
• Discarding rotting and over-ripened produce following our quality standards
• Operating small tractors, when required
• Loading picked fresh produce into containers
• Digging and planting/transplanting seedlings by hand

To be successful in these roles you will possess the following:

• Evidence of work rights.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with a can-do attitude
• Team player who can work effectively with people from different backgrounds.
• Awareness and ability to adhere to WHS requirements.
• Flexibility in hours worked to achieve operational targets, including weekends and public holidays.


In return we offer you

• A passionate and energetic team culture.
• Become a part of a progressive, vibrant business.

Number of positions available: 182 total. 

Commencement date: from: March 2027 to November 2027 for 9 months. 
Renumeration: Starting at $32.18/hr (Horticulture Award 2020, Level 1). You will then progress to $33.05 (Horticulture Award 2020, Level 2) after 3 months of continuous employment. 

Who we are?
Rombola Family Farms are located 20kms North of Griffith, NSW and in Mataranka, NT. Our company is a progressive, vibrant, privately owned agricultural business. We are involved in a range of agricultural enterprises including melons, pumpkins, broccoli, citrus, wine grapes and almonds, with operations spanning growing, packing, and marketing of produce.

More information
For more information or a confidential discussion please contact Human Resources at hr@rombolafamilyfarms.com.au. To learn more about working with us, we encourage you to visit our website http://www.rombolafamilyfarms.com/

With around 3,500 people across approximately 150 locations, we deliver outstanding customer service and get over 300,000 people and businesses back on the road every year. With AMA Group, you can go anywhere.

 

 CAPITAL SMART 

With over 50 repair centres across Australia and New Zealand, Capital S.M.A.R.T is the industry leader We are the pioneers of customer satisfaction and innovation standards, and pride ourselves on providing our employees with safe, supportive, and rewarding working conditions. With an extensive network across Australia and New Zealand, as part of our Team, you can go anywhere.

 

ACM PARTS

ACM Parts is Australia’s largest provider of alternative and specialty parts to the automotive repair industry, keeping vehicles on the road. We are reimaging the way vehicles can be repaired by providing a choice of options that suit their needs. We offer a comprehensive range of Reclaimed, Genuine, and Aftermarket parts as. ACM Parts is reinventing the quality and service standards of the repair industry. It’s our mission to re-define and repair.

 

The Opportunity
We have an exciting opportunity for Centre Manager at either of our AMA Group Solutions or Capital S.M.A.R.T Repairs team. This is a full time position. 

Reporting to the State Operations Manager, you will take ownership of this centre by providing leadership and motivation to your team whilst having a significant impact on the day to day operational running of the site. This permanent full-time role will be provide you with opportunities for growth, stability and security as part of the bigger AMA Group. 

Role responsibilities
Production Workshop Management: oversee production management of the workshop to ensure targets are achieved and vehicles are repaired to their pre-accident condition in accordance with AMA and Work Provider quality expectations.

Quality, Quotes, Parts and Vehicle Management: ensure comprehensive and accurate quotes, QA inspections and vehicles are repaired to their pre-accident condition. 
Customer Service and Stakeholder Management: provide exceptional customer service to all clients and work providers through prompt, professional and friendly interactions.
Profit and Loss, Reporting and Administration: ensure the site is operating profitability. Prepare and review P&Ls, Budgets, Job costings, KPIs, Management Reports by utilising the tools provided to understand site performance.
Leadership and People Management: oversee staffing on site and ensure staffing levels and processes are in place. Proactively build and maintain positive work provider relationships.
Work Health and Safety (WHS): ensure that the site remains safe by maintaining the WHS management system, all WHS policies and procedures are followed and safety incidences/near misses are immediately reported and actioned.
 

Benefits

Reward & recognition
Career development and training
Referral bonus for recommending a friend to work with us
Discounts on parts and tools
Uniforms
24/7 professional counselling for Team members and their immediate families
We champion our Team, because it’s our people that set us apart and drive our business' success. We focus on individual strengths and value differences to bring the best out of people, enhancing their skills and capabilities to build fulfilling careers. 

AMA Group is an equal opportunity employer. We are dedicated to finding the best fit for every role. All qualified applications will be considered regardless of gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, disability, or sexual orientation.

No matter who you are, if you have the drive and talent to progress, when you’re part of our Team, you’re going places - APPLY NOW.

Role Summary:

Lead the Trading Activation of addressable marketing strategies via a team through market understanding, solution development skills, technical DSP/DMP/CDP expertise, and the communication of KINESSO recommendations through trusted agency & client relationships to meet client media objectives.

The Senior Activations Manager ensures all pacing and performance goals are met across all Addressable campaigns and acts as the trading lead across their client patch. Where applicable, they are responsible for the training, mentorship, and delegation of tasks to their direct reports/ junior trading members and are expected to be leaders in strategic thinking and optimization tactics. Ability to compare/contrast ad tech partners and recommend the best tools for a particular campaign are key.

Key Responsibilities

Partnership
1. industry changes, uncover benefits and Develop and nurture strong relationships with Agency team and direct clients to become a trusted source of Trading knowledge, owning the Trading relationship of a client portfolio.

2. Manage relationships with AdTech vendors and media partners to remain at the forefront of opportunities for clients to deliver business outcomes.

3. Collaborate with the Client Advisory team to extract optimal campaign performance and fulfill client objectives. Assist CA in brief responses and attend meetings as required.

4. Develop and nurture relationships with the wider Kinesso team, becoming a trusted source they can come to for questions around client insights, trading best practices etc.

Product

1. Provide insights to your Client Services and/or Agency Teams to assist with the overall digital strategy of future campaigns. Leading the charge on thought leadership across activations, encouraging innovation and test and learn opportunities to drive strategy.

2. Work with your Programmatic & Ad Ops Lead and the Digital Technology Manager to drive a culture of technology testing within your team.

3. Lead Campaign optimization strategies, training on new strategies and review/evaluation of these strategies, on behalf of your client.

4. Take lead in developing a measurement framework for your client patch.

5. Collaborate with Client Advisory & Product teams to ideate bespoke projects based on brand requirements, supporting digital acceleration and transformation.

Profile

1. Provide agency partners with thought leadership and education via curation of case studies for internal knowledge share.

2. Present relevant topics to the wider business to promote Kinesso solutions/results and share knowledge.

3. Participation in industry events for Kinesso representation and individual network growth.

4. Where possible, lead Kinesso involvement in client presentations.

Performance

1. Work to drive an overall trading vision for the client, driving the wider trading team to bring this to life.

2. Work with the Client Advisory team to push for client presentations showcasing trading outcomes, thought leadership work etc.

3. Identify direct reports knowledge gaps to familiarize with Kinesso solutions.

4. Lead campaign KPI fulfilment on behalf of client portfolio. Collaborate with Client Advisory team to extract optimal campaign performance, fulfill client objectives and hero campaign results through an insights led approach.

5. Assist in implementing processes to drive efficiencies within your client patch

6. Identify and assist in creation of innovation and test & learn projects.

7. Identify and lead digital growth opportunities for clients via channel diversification

People

1. Mentor, train and coach Client Advisory Associate (hybrid coordinator) and Trading Managers through an on-boarding and development framework.

2. If Applicable, Manage Associates and/or Managers, being responsible for their training and development within Kinesso

3. Provide daily direction to trading team via task management and prioritization in line with agency requests and client SLA’s.

4. Accountable for fostering culture within the team.


Salary between $86,000 to $90,000 inclusive of superannuation.

result.description: MELBOURNE SCOOTERS PTY LTD   About the Role   The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the day-to-day retail operations of the store, ensuring effective stock control, customer service excellence, sales performance, staff supervision, and operational efficiency. Reporting directly to senior management, the Store Manager will play a key role in achieving business objectives and maintaining high standards across the retail environment.   Key Responsibilities      - Determine product mix, stock levels, and service standards to meet customer demand and business objectives.  - Formulate and implement purchasing, merchandising, and marketing strategies.  - Set and review pricing of products and services in accordance with market conditions and business goals.  - Promote and advertise the business's products, services, and special offers.  - Monitor sales performance and implement strategies to maximise revenue and profitability.  - Sell products and services while providing expert advice and assistance to customers.  - Maintain accurate records of inventory, stock movements, sales activities, and financial transactions.  - Coordinate stock ordering, supplier relationships, and inventory management processes.  - Prepare budgets, monitor business performance, and assist in achieving financial targets.  - Recruit, train, supervise, and support retail staff to ensure high levels of productivity and customer service.  - Ensure compliance with company policies, workplace health and safety requirements, and operational procedures.  - Handle customer enquiries, complaints, and service issues in a professional and timely manner.  - Maintain store presentation standards and ensure an organised, safe, and efficient retail environment.      Skills and Qualifications      - AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma, Diploma, or equivalent qualification.  - Minimum 1 year of relevant full-time work experience in a retail management, store management, or supervisory role.  - Strong leadership, communication, and organisational skills.  - Experience in stock control, inventory management, budgeting, and staff supervision.  - Ability to manage daily retail operations and achieve sales and business targets.  - Strong customer service and problem-solving skills.  - Knowledge of workplace health and safety requirements.  - Experience within the motorcycle, automotive, retail, or related industry will be highly regarded.      What We Offer      - Competitive salary package of $75,000 – $95,000 per annum plus superannuation.  - Opportunity to work with a growing and established Melbourne business.  - Supportive and professional team environment.  - Long-term career development and advancement opportunities.  - Opportunity to contribute to the growth and success of a respected motorcycle dealership and service business.  About Company     Melbourne Scooters Pty Ltd is a well-established motorcycle dealership and service business operating in Melbourne. Our operations include motorcycle sales, spare parts retailing, servicing, customer support, and workshop services. We are committed to delivering high-quality products and exceptional customer service while maintaining strong operational standards across all areas of the business.    Due to continued business growth, we are seeking an experienced and motivated Store Manager to oversee the daily operations of our retail and customer service functions and support the ongoing success of the business. Arise Infra Pty Ltd, located in Reedy Creek, QLD, is seeking a skilled and motivated Civil Engineering Technician to join its growing team on a full-time basis. Arise Infra Pty Ltd is a Queensland-based business operating in the residential design and construction space, with a strong focus on tailored home design solutions and a client-centred approach to project delivery. The business is built around customised design outcomes, practical planning and close collaboration with clients throughout the design and building process, and presents itself as a Queensland home-building and custom design studio that delivers bespoke homes and supports clients across every stage of their project. This role will suit a candidate who can support civil and site works, carry out technical assessments and testing, and contribute to the accurate and compliant delivery of the infrastructure that underpins the company’s residential projects.

Position: Civil Engineering Technician

Location: Reedy Creek, QLD

Key Responsibilities
•	Interpreting project briefs, engineering instructions and work assignments to determine suitable methods, procedures and equipment for each civil and site-related task across the company’s residential and associated development projects
•	Preparing sketches, plans, layouts, schedules, charts and tabulations for civil works such as site drainage, stormwater management, water and sewer service connections, internal access roads, driveways, pavements and other supporting infrastructure
•	Collecting, reviewing and analysing site and project data and carrying out calculations relating to levels, grades, quantities, drainage capacities and material requirements
•	Carrying out and directing on-site fieldwork and related testing to support design, set-out and construction activities across active project sites
•	Conducting and arranging field and laboratory testing of soils, fill and construction materials to confirm their suitability for foundations, pavements and earthworks, and gathering site, access and survey data to inform servicing and traffic arrangements for developments
•	Estimating material quantities and costs for civil and site works and helping ensure that completed works meet project specifications, relevant standards, approval conditions and contract provisions
•	Inspecting civil and site works during and after construction and organising and supervising any required rectification, maintenance or repair to maintain quality and compliance
•	Preparing the supporting civil documentation, drawings and technical data required for council and authority submissions, approvals and construction certification
•	Checking dimensions, levels, set-out and site details against approved plans to support accuracy and buildability on site
•	Liaising with designers, engineers, surveyors, contractors, site supervisors and external consultants to coordinate civil and construction information across each project
•	Maintaining organised records of site data, test results, calculations, drawings and revisions for project control and future reference
•	Monitoring works on site to confirm they are completed in line with relevant building, drainage and construction standards and practical site conditions
•	Contributing to continuous improvement in technical processes, documentation quality and efficiency across the company’s projects

Skills and Experience
•	at least 1 year of relevant work experience
•	an AQF associate degree, advanced diploma or diploma in a relevant field

Personal Attributes
•	strong attention to detail and a commitment to accurate, high-quality technical work
•	able to manage competing deadlines and adapt to changing project priorities
•	a clear communicator with a collaborative, team-focused approach
•	practical, methodical and solution-focused in approach
•	reliable and capable of working both independently and as part of a project team, on site and in the office

Employment Type: Full-time | Hours: 38 hours per week

Salary: $75,000 to $85,000 plus superannuation per annum

If you are a capable Civil Engineering Technician looking for a full-time opportunity in Reedy Creek, QLD, we encourage you to apply.

result.description:
Position: ICT Project Manager
Type: Full-time
Employer: Mienterprise Pty Ltd
Location: Melbourne VIC
Salary: $100,000 p/a
About the Business:
Mienterprise Pty Ltd, trading as SENPOS, is a leading Australian point-of-sale technology company with over 30 years of experience delivering powerful, integrated POS solutions to hospitality venues, golf clubs, and entertainment establishments across Australia and New Zealand. With offices in Newcastle, Wollongong, Gold Coast, and Rockhampton, SENPOS combines home-grown software and hardware development with exceptional local support to streamline operations, enhance customer engagement, and drive business profitability. We pride ourselves on building long-lasting partnerships, providing responsive 24/7 support, and fostering a collaborative, innovative workplace culture where team members contribute to cutting-edge projects that make a real difference for our clients.
About the Position:
The ICT Project Manager leads the end-to-end delivery of point of sale implementation projects for our clients across hospitality, retail, and entertainment. Reporting to Strategy and Ops, the role plans, coordinates, and delivers multiple concurrent projects, manages system integrations, and ensures a smooth transition from initiation through to go-live and handover to Support, all within agreed timeframes and budgets.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead and manage multiple implementation projects simultaneously, from initiation through to post go-live review.
Define project scope, objectives, timelines, deliverables, and resource requirements in collaboration with stakeholders.
Develop and maintain project plans and communication logs.
Coordinate across internal teams, including implementations, development, support, product, and training, to ensure deliverables meet quality standards.
Monitor project progress and proactively identify risks, dependencies, and mitigation strategies.
Manage and configure all system integrations, including payment gateways, EFTPOS and payment terminals, POS hardware, access control, online ordering and websites, and third-party vendor connections, ensuring successful end-to-end connectivity and testing.
Conduct regular project status meetings with clients and internal teams.
Manage client expectations and ensure alignment on priorities and deliverables.
Oversee testing, data validation, and handover to the Support team following go-live.
Support the continuous improvement of implementation methodologies and documentation.
Contribute to internal and client-facing process improvement initiatives.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Tertiary qualification (Bachelor level) in ICT or a related field.
Minimum 5–10 years of experience in ICT project management.
Highly desirable: demonstrated experience within point of sale (POS), IT, or club management systems.
Strong technical skills in project management methodologies, system integrations, POS hardware/software, and ICT security practices.
Excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage client expectations.
Proven ability to deliver multiple concurrent projects on time and within budget in a fast-paced, client-facing environment.
How to Apply:
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
